positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.locationName: Aztec, New Mexico, United States · Remote

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Tools for managing and classifying defects in masks used for chip fabrication.

• Designed and implemented Web UI for portions of new product, DPM (Defect Progression Monitor) using PHP, HTML, jQuery, MySQL.
• Fixed bugs in existing code.
• Refactored existing code into libraries in order to reduce code duplication, simplify code base. The
libraries facilitated improvements in performance, eliminated bugs, and eased the implementation
of new functionality.
• Designed and implemented an internal auditing tool to track performance of automated defect
detection/classification over the lifetime of a chip mask.
• Analyzed and improved performance of common MySQL queries.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
http://gpsprot.org - A web-based tool for mapping Human-HIV protein interaction networks.

Maintain and update website, using PHP, jQuery, MySQL and a Java applet: • Bug fixes, migrate servers, new search features.

• MySQL database administration.
• Import/update data from new sources.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Flurbit.com Event search engine, ticket sales (later became eventguru.com)

• Designed and implemented system allowing users to post events, sell tickets and pay commissions to affiliates using PayPal API, LAMP stack (Linux, Apache, MySQL, Python), HTML5 and jQuery.
• Developed interface to back-end search engine allowing event search and micro-payments to users for verifying spidered events using PayPal API and LAMP stack.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Connecting restaurants to potential customers via social networking.

• Developed an interactive tool for restaurants to create, manage and view reports for customer sur- veys using XHTML and jQuery. Based on supplied Photoshop screenshot mockups.
• Implemented several restaurant websites based on Photoshop screen mockups.
• Created a tool using PHP and jQuery to assist creation/testing of XHTML template chunks, which
the proprietary backend would use to create custom pages for restaurant websites.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Social networking website with emphasis on realtime business collaboration, based on LAMP stack (Linux/Apache/MySQL, PHP)

• Database design/administration (MySQL).
• Developed, enhanced tools for online communication (realtime chat, videoconferencing) using
jQuery, Flash and PHP. (Both server and client side scripting)
• Developed a dynamic desktop window layout system using PHP and jQuery.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Embedded system for government contractor.
· Developed code for 8051-based USB interface controller on proprietary peripheral device.
· Worked with software team to develop linux host interface to USB device.
· Worked with hardware team and specs to control device components.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
High-performance search engine solutions.
Enhanced and expanded core offering:
· Systemwide support for Unicode
· Boolean query engine.
· Contextual summary generator.
· Language recognition.
· Blog page identification, parsing, sectioning.
· High-volume targeted web spidering optimizations.
· RSS/Atom feed support.
· Maintained and administrated production clusters.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Weather risk analysis tools for energy traders.
· Developed and maintained system for fetching and ingesting weather observation data (METAR) and raw
  forecast data from multiple sources and formats.
· Developed tools for generating weather map graphics from gridded data or text forecast/observation data.
· Developed tools to generate location based numerical forecasts from gridded data.
· Developed tools for graphical analysis of historical forecasts and generation of custom statistical forecasts.
· Maintained and administrated production clusters.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed media control systems for schools.
· Developed system for controlling remote media resources such as TVs, VCRs, DVD players, digital media files
or Broadcast TV using a variety of interfaces, including IR, serial and TCP/IP.
· Worked with hardware engineer to develop controller code for 8051-based set-top box.
· Developed scheduling software to reserve media devices or schedule playback.
· Developed GUI client applications for for device control, media scheduling and administration for Windows,
Mac OS, Unix (Novell UnixWare, Linux, X11, Motif) and web browsers (Perl, Apache, Javascript).
